tasks.title: Topic Tab icon rail and Agent identity inspector
tasks.objective: Condense Topic topology while keeping each Tab and Agent understandable.
tasks.outcome: Single-Region Tabs use the Region icon, split Tabs use a square layout glyph, mounted Agent duplicates disappear, and the inspector shows Agent avatars beside activity.
acceptance: Each one-Region Tab renders one actual Agent avatar or one matching surface icon without an empty inset tile; each split Tab renders its true Region bounds in a square glyph.
The Topic row does not render a separate Agent avatar for a Session represented in any of its Tabs, including inactive Tabs; live Agents with no Tab remain reachable.
Hover/focus inspector shows the configured Agent avatar with its name, surface type and recent activity; Tab order, active state, Topic opening and viewport portal remain intact.
Focused behavior tests turn red when the identity or de-duplication path is broken; production caller is present outside the component definition.

verification.ref: pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/topic-agent-status.test.ts test/topic-region-mosaic.test.tsx test/selector-presence-shape.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
verification.proves: Topic Tab icon and inspector rendering plus Agent roster behavior.
Changed component and styles compile cleanly.
TopicPresence is connected to the product Topic row outside its definition.
